title: ai hooks: a project-local Claude Code hooks snippet
lead: `slicer ai hooks` prints a Claude Code hooks snippet for this project: a SessionStart hook that feeds `slicer ai getting-started` into a new session's context when `.slicer/` exists, and a PreToolUse hook that denies Read, Grep, Edit and Write on slicer's tracking files with a reason that names the CLI read to use instead. `--install` merges it into the project's `.claude/settings.json`, never `~/.claude`, refusing a conflicting slicer entry unless `--force`.
findings_note: owner request 2026-11-02 (release 1.18.0, helping an agent get started): decision 3, `slicer ai hooks [--install] [--force]` printing or installing a project-local Claude Code hooks snippet (SessionStart pointing at `slicer ai getting-started`; a PreToolUse guard denying Read/Grep/Edit/Write on tracking files); hooks format verified against code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks and /permissions on 2026-11-02
boundary: **Not in this slice:** user-level settings (`~/.claude/settings.json`) or `.claude/settings.local.json`; Codex or Grok hooks; blocking Bash commands such as `cat .slicer/index.json` or a Grep with no path from the project root; the skill rewrite; uninstalling hooks.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner request 2026-11-02, decision 3: add `slicer ai hooks [--install] [--force]`, which prints or installs a project-local Claude Code hooks snippet, for example SessionStart pointing at `slicer ai getting-started` when `.slicer` exists, and a PreToolUse guard denying Read/Grep/Edit/Write on `.slicer/*.json`, `log.jsonl` and `render/`. Project-local `.claude/settings.json` only, never `~/.claude`; merge-safe (refuse on conflict, `--force` semantics like `ai skill --install`). Codex and Grok parity is out of scope.

The tracking rule (never open `.slicer/` state) is today enforced only by prose in the skill, AGENTS.md and `ai instructions`; agents still open the files (this repo's memory has a standing rule about it). A harness-level deny turns the rule into a refusal with a pointer to the right command.

Claude Code hooks format, verified 2026-11-02 from https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions:

- Settings files: `~/.claude/settings.json` (all projects), `.claude/settings.json` (one project, committable), `.claude/settings.local.json` (one project, not shared). Hook entries from different levels merge rather than replace.
- Shape: `{"hooks": {"EVENT": [{"matcher": "...", "hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "...", "timeout": N}]}]}}`. Optional handler fields include `args` (exec form, no shell), `shell` (`bash` default), `if` (one permission rule such as `Edit(*.ts)`, tool events only), `async`, `statusMessage`, `once`.
- `command` without `args` is shell form: run by `sh -c` on macOS and Linux (Git Bash, else PowerShell, on Windows); `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` is set to the project root where the session started. With `args`, `command` is spawned directly with no shell.
- Matcher: only letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,` and `|` is an exact name or list (`Read|Grep|Edit|Write`); any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regex.
- SessionStart: matcher values `startup`, `resume`, `clear`, `compact`, `fork`; stdin carries `source`. Plain stdout is added to Claude's context; JSON `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` does the same. No blocking. Only `command` and `mcp_tool` handlers.
- PreToolUse stdin: `session_id`, `transcript_path`, `cwd`, `permission_mode`, `hook_event_name`, `tool_name`, `tool_input`, `tool_use_id`. `tool_input.file_path` (always absolute) for Read, Write and Edit; Grep has `pattern`, optional `path`, optional `glob`; Glob has `pattern` and optional `path`.
- PreToolUse deny: print `{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "..."}}` and exit 0, or exit 2 with the reason on stderr; both block the call and show Claude the reason. Decisions are `allow`, `deny`, `ask`, `defer`; across hooks `deny` wins. A non-zero exit other than 2 is a non-blocking error.
- Alternative native mechanism: `permissions.deny` rules such as `Read(/.slicer/**/*.json)` (a leading `/` is relative to the settings file's project); Edit rules cover every built-in edit tool, Read rules apply to Grep and Glob only "best-effort".

sections.heading: Files
Failing tests
sections.body:
In `tests/test_ai_hooks.py`:

- `test_AiHooks_Print_IsTheSnippetAndWritesNothing`: stdout equals `jsonio.dumps(ai.hooks_settings())`; the tree is unchanged.
- `test_AiHooks_Snippet_KeyOrderAndCommands`: event order `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`; matchers `startup|clear|compact` and `Read|Grep|Edit|Write`; the commands name `slicer ai getting-started` and `slicer ai guard`.
- `test_AiHooksInstall_NoSettings_CreatesProjectSettings` and `test_AiHooksInstall_NeverWritesUnderHome` (HOME pointed at a temp dir that stays empty).
- `test_AiHooksInstall_ExistingSettings_KeepsOtherKeysAndGroups` (permissions, env and a user's own PreToolUse group survive in order).
- `test_AiHooksInstall_AlreadyInstalled_WritesNothing` (`written: []`, mtime unchanged).
- `test_AiHooksInstall_ConflictingSlicerGroup_RefusesAndWritesNothing` (exit 2, code `state`) and `test_AiHooksInstall_Force_ReplacesTheSlicerGroupInPlace`.
- `test_AiHooksInstall_InvalidJson_IsStateAndWritesNothing`; `test_AiHooksInstall_OutsideAProject_IsRefused`; `test_AiHooks_ForceWithoutInstall_IsUsage`.
- `test_AiHooks_Json_SettingsThenWritten`.
- `test_AiGuard_ReadIndex_Denies`, `test_AiGuard_EditSliceJson_Denies`, `test_AiGuard_WriteLog_Denies`, `test_AiGuard_ReadRender_Denies`, `test_AiGuard_GrepSlicerDir_Denies`: stdout is the deny object with the reason, exit 0.
- `test_AiGuard_ReadTemplateOrPrompt_Allows`, `test_AiGuard_ReadSource_Allows`, `test_AiGuard_PathOutsideProject_Allows`: empty stdout, exit 0.
- `test_AiGuard_MalformedStdin_AllowsSilently`.
- `test_AiGuard_Reason_NamesTheCliReads`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `hooks_settings`, `GUARD_REASON` and `guard_decision` in `ai.py`, with unit tests on the pure functions first.
2. `cmd_ai_guard`, then `cmd_ai_hooks` with the merge rules; reuse `jsonio.read`/`jsonio.write` and the refusal wording of `_write_skill`.
3. Docs, the JSON-exception sentence in the four docs, CHANGELOG.
4. Try the installed snippet in a scratch project with Claude Code when available and record the result in the closing note as a `[HUMAN CHECK]` if it cannot be run.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- [ ] `slicer ai hooks` prints the snippet above and writes nothing.
- [ ] `--install` creates or merges `PROJECT/.claude/settings.json` only, keeps every other key and group, is a no-op when installed, and refuses a conflicting slicer group unless `--force`; nothing is ever written under `~/.claude`.
- [ ] `slicer ai guard` denies Read, Edit and Write on `.slicer/**/*.json`, `.slicer/log.jsonl` and `.slicer/render/**` and Grep on those paths or the `.slicer`, `slices` or `render` directories, with the CLI reason; it allows templates, prompts, source and paths outside the project, and fails open on bad input.
- [ ] [HUMAN CHECK] In a scratch project with the snippet installed, a new Claude Code session shows the getting-started text, and a Read of `.slicer/index.json` is denied with the reason.
- [ ] Docs, the JSON-exception sentence and CHANGELOG are updated; `tests/test_docs_coverage.py` passes.
- [ ] `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, the full suite, `slicer check` and `git diff --check` pass.
